# @teispace/env

> 标签: bun, cloudflare-workers, config, deno, dotenv, env, environment-variables, nestjs, nextjs, nuxt, standard-schema, type-safe, typescript, valibot, validation, vite, zod

## 简介

Type-safe, validated environment variables for every JavaScript runtime and framework. Load, validate, coerce, and type your env — Node, Bun, Deno, Workers, Next, Nest, Vite, Nuxt, and more.
